anomalies: The first final normal reconnect froze the miniscreen at the initial logo; a second disconnect/reconnect recovered normally. The isolated event is unexplained and is not attributed to the candidate as a proven root cause.

The pre-restore temporary Config SHA-256 was be222f6828b97d5dc9c8a5aab0276a82a0eed4e5846d01d24081936076ccd327 instead of the originally written 02a456e4868d659e6c54bff7f2b5d26d069755496089c4ab2cd266b084e5e589. Structured comparison found only the GameCube communication backend default_mode_config changing from 3 to 13. This is source-explained as a consequence of using the Profile menu to select Ult13: SetDefaultMode writes index+1 to watchdog scratch, and backend initialization persists that value; it is not unexplained field drift.

The owner newly noticed that LT1 displays LB on the miniscreen. Candidate source sets both internal buttonL and triggerLDigital for LT1 and sets analog L to 140; the GameCube report sends triggerLDigital as L, the dashboard prioritizes buttonL as LB, and the Switch button test observed only L. This is recorded as source-consistent display behavior, not an extra transmitted GameCube button.
